maturity_summary: Beta means a published 0.x library line. The public API may change between minor versions. This is not general availability, and it is not a claim that a public network is in production.

publication.native_archive_contents: 29 legacy libexo_*.rlib libraries each, not server executables

gap_registry.note: GAP-REGISTRY.md is the systemic integrity ledger. Its header was amended on 2026-07-02 and still records the v0.2.0-beta runtime snapshot, so that header is not the 0.2.7 publication record. Named gap rows remain the ledger for unfinished claims. The default-off features below are the current source boundary for unaudited surfaces.

default_off_features.boundary: SNARK, STARK, and ZKML entry points refuse to run unless this feature is enabled. The crate is a pedagogical skeleton, not production cryptography.
Bearer-token validator-set changes stay refused. Enabling the feature does not complete quorum governance.
Compatibility feature name only. It does not authorize a live CrossChecked anchor, and POST /api/v1/receipts returns 410 in every build.
MCP tools that would return success without persisting governance state stay refused.
First-touch 0dentity claim creation stays refused until an approved proof-of-possession contract exists.
Infrastructure Holons stay off. The default build has no external attestation source for their root authority.
Device-fingerprint and behavioral-biometric axes stay off. There is no public ingestion path that persists those samples.
Hermetic AVC tests may swap root-trust constants. Production ceremony constants stay compiled either way, and this feature must stay off for a production build.
The GraphQL API stays off. Its resolvers include unaudited mutations, fabricated consent evaluation, and proof-verification scaffolding.

bounded_capabilities.name: RISC Zero execution-receipt verifier
bounded_capabilities.posture: exochain-proofs compiles risc0-verifier by default. Receipt verification is not production-reviewed. Pedagogical SNARK, STARK, and ZKML proofs remain behind unaudited-pedagogical-proofs.

bounded_capabilities.name: Gateway readiness
bounded_capabilities.posture: GET /ready is served by exo-gateway and reports CARGO_PKG_VERSION plus database probe state. The v0.2.7 GitHub Release claims no runtime deployment, so a live probe describes that process only.
